sentences.zh: 但玛蒂尔达在1135年12月面临的问题是，她在1133年生了小亨利。

sentences.en: But the problem for Matilda in December 1135 is she's had little baby Henry in 1133.
sentences.zh: 然后她在1134年生了小若弗鲁瓦，生他时差点死掉。

sentences.en: She then had little baby Geoffrey in 1134 and nearly died having him.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，真的非常危险，差点就死了。

sentences.en: I mean, really seriously nearly died.
sentences.zh: 在1135年秋天，她又怀孕了。

sentences.en: In the autumn of 1135, she's pregnant again.
sentences.zh: 在1135年秋天，她又怀孕了。

sentences.en: She's in the very early stages of pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 她正处于怀孕的极早期阶段。

sentences.en: And another occupational hazard for medieval women, her husband and her father have fallen out.
sentences.zh: 对于中世纪女性来说，另一个职业风险是她丈夫和父亲闹翻了。

sentences.en: So she's in Anjou with her husband in the very early stages of pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 所以她正和丈夫待在安茹，处于怀孕的极早期阶段。

sentences.en: So she's not in England ready to be anointed.
sentences.zh: 因此她没在英格兰准备接受涂油礼。

sentences.en: She is not in the right place at the right time.
sentences.zh: 她没能在正确的时间出现在正确的地点。

sentences.en: And she's going to struggle to get there because she's pregnant.
sentences.zh: 而且因为怀孕，她很难赶到那里。

sentences.en: She's not been well.
sentences.zh: 她身体一直不太好。

sentences.en: She gets a certain way.
sentences.zh: 她走了一段路。

sentences.en: She gets into Normandy, just into Normandy.
sentences.zh: 她进入了诺曼底，刚进入诺曼底。

sentences.en: But that's still a long way from the coronation chair.
sentences.zh: 但这离加冕椅还有很长一段距离。

sentences.en: I suppose to apply the masculine perspective, a woman never looks, from the male point of view,
sentences.zh: 我想从男性的视角来看，一个女人在怀孕时，

sentences.en: less suited to playing the masculine role of a king than when she's pregnant.
sentences.zh: 看起来最不适合扮演国王这种男性角色。

sentences.en: That's exactly it.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And married, of course, to the Count of Anjou, who the Anglo-Norman baronage are used to thinking of as an enemy.
sentences.zh: 当然，她还嫁给了安茹伯爵，而盎格鲁-诺曼男爵们习惯于把他视为敌人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So all in all...
sentences.zh: 所以总而言之……

sentences.en: So it's all tricky.
sentences.zh: 情况很棘手。

sentences.en: So I suppose in a situation like that, where the pregnant queen is not in England, there are opportunities for someone to do a Henry I
sentences.zh: 所以我认为在那种情况下，当怀孕的王后不在英格兰时，有人就有机会效仿亨利一世，

sentences.en: and rush off and go to England and get yourself anointed and become the king in situ.
sentences.zh: 赶紧跑去英格兰，让自己受膏，当场成为国王。

sentences.en: And is that what happens?
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样发生的吗？

sentences.en: One man among the Anglo-Norman barons has been paying very close attention to the lessons of history, which I know is what we all think everyone ought to be doing all the time.
sentences.zh: 盎格鲁-诺曼男爵中有一个人一直在密切关注历史教训，我知道我们都认为每个人应该时刻这样做。

sentences.en: The rest of the barons are accompanying Henry's body very slowly back from Normandy to England.
sentences.zh: 其余的男爵正护送亨利的遗体从诺曼底缓慢返回英格兰。

sentences.en: And they're having meetings about who could become king, because obviously we don't really want the pregnant woman.
sentences.zh: 他们正在开会讨论谁能成为国王，因为显然我们真的不想要那个怀孕的女人。

sentences.en: And they come up with this idea that Henry I's nephew,
sentences.zh: 他们想出了一个主意，亨利一世的侄子，

sentences.en: Theobald of Blois, one of their number, might be a good idea.
sentences.zh: 布卢瓦的西奥博尔德，他们中的一员，可能是一个好人选。

sentences.en: I mean, all due respect to Theo, our erstwhile producer, but you can't have someone called Theo as king of England.
sentences.zh: 我是说，虽然尊重西奥，我们以前的制片人，但你不能让一个叫西奥的人当英格兰国王。

sentences.en: You can't, can you?
sentences.zh: 你不能，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, that is a rule, I think.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这是一条规则。

sentences.en: But Theobald has a younger brother called Stephen, who's married to the heiress to Boulogne, which is very handy for getting to England.
sentences.zh: 但西奥博尔德有个弟弟叫斯蒂芬，他娶了布洛涅的女继承人，这对去英格兰非常方便。

sentences.en: He has paid attention to what his uncle did when he became king.
sentences.zh: 他注意到了他叔叔当上国王时所做的一切。

sentences.en: He jumps on his horse, gets to the coast, gets on a ship, jumps back on a horse, gets himself to Winchester, takes control of the royal treasury
sentences.zh: 他跳上马，赶到海岸，登上船，再跳上马，赶到温彻斯特，控制了皇家国库，

sentences.en: and then has himself crowned and anointed before anyone else knows what's happening.
sentences.zh: 然后在别人还没反应过来之前就让自己加冕受膏了。

sentences.en: So the sacred oil has seeped into his skin and he is now impregnated.
sentences.zh: 所以圣油已经渗入了他的皮肤，他现在被“受孕”了。

sentences.en: He is impregnated.
sentences.zh: 他被“受孕”了。

sentences.en: With this kind of sacramental oil.
sentences.zh: 用这种圣油。

sentences.en: With kingship.
sentences.zh: 用王权。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so at this point, you have two different kinds of royal legitimacy standing in opposition to one another.
sentences.zh: 所以此时，你有两种不同的王权合法性在相互对立。

sentences.en: Because you have the hereditary principle vested in Matilda.
sentences.zh: 因为你有赋予玛蒂尔达的世袭原则。

sentences.en: She's been named his heir by the previous king and all the barons have sworn allegiance to her.
sentences.zh: 她被前任国王指定为继承人，所有的男爵都向她宣誓效忠。

sentences.en: I suppose some of them have a kind of personal loyalty to Henry and therefore to his daughter too.
sentences.zh: 我想他们中的一些人对亨利有一种个人忠诚，因此也对他的女儿忠诚。

sentences.en: Absolutely they do.
sentences.zh: 他们绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Even though she's this weaker vessel, she's the wrong sex.
sentences.zh: 尽管她是较弱的一方，性别也不对。

sentences.en: But yes, Henry has designated her his heir and she does have sons.
sentences.zh: 但确实，亨利已经指定她为继承人，而且她确实有儿子。

sentences.en: So the bloodline will continue through Matilda.
sentences.zh: 所以血统将通过玛蒂尔达延续下去。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, you have Stephen who isn't even the oldest son in his own family.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，斯蒂芬甚至不是他自己家族中最年长的儿子。

sentences.en: His older brother is still alive but he has been crowned and anointed.
sentences.zh: 他的哥哥还活着，但他已经加冕受膏了。

sentences.en: He now is a king, whether you like it or not.
sentences.zh: 不管你喜不喜欢，他现在就是国王。

sentences.en: So I suppose one solution might be that she stays in Normandy and becomes the kind of the Duchess of Normandy or whatever and Stephen stays in England.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为一个解决方案可能是她留在诺曼底，成为诺曼底公爵夫人之类的，而斯蒂芬留在英格兰。

sentences.en: But that's not really possible, is it?
sentences.zh: 但这不太可能，不是吗？

sentences.en: Because all the barons and so like, they have lands in both Normandy and England and so they do need someone who can kind of preside over both realMs.
sentences.zh: 因为所有的男爵等等，他们在诺曼底和英格兰都有土地，所以他们确实需要一个能统领这两个王国的人。

sentences.en: They do.
sentences.zh: 他们确实需要。

sentences.en: They need a king, a duke in Normandy but they need someone who can provide them with order, with justice, leadership in war.
sentences.zh: 他们需要一位国王，一位诺曼底公爵，但他们需要一个能为他们提供秩序、正义和战争领导力的人。

sentences.en: We also have to remember this is a time when frontiers between states are exactly that, they're frontiers.
sentences.zh: 我们还必须记住，这是一个国家边界就是边界的时代。

sentences.en: If you are not defending your frontiers, someone else is going to pour over them with their army.
sentences.zh: 如果你不保卫你的边界，别人就会带着军队涌进来。

sentences.en: So the idea that you could just leave your lands in Normandy for someone else to look after is not viable.
sentences.zh: 所以认为你可以把诺曼底的土地留给别人打理的想法是行不通的。

sentences.en: So this is a real problem then.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实是个大问题。

sentences.en: I mean, what happens?
sentences.zh: 我是说，后来怎么样了？

sentences.en: How do they resolve this problem?
sentences.zh: 他们如何解决这个问题？

sentences.en: Initially, it looks as though Stephen has won.
sentences.zh: 起初，看起来斯蒂芬赢了。

sentences.en: That kind of decisive seizing the moment and the fact that he's not only been anointed as a king but he looks like he can do the job.
sentences.zh: 那种果断抓住时机的能力，以及他不仅被涂油为王，而且看起来能胜任这份工作的事实。

sentences.en: He is a man.
sentences.zh: 他是个男人。

sentences.en: He can lead in war.
sentences.zh: 他能领导战争。

sentences.en: He can offer justice.
sentences.zh: 他能主持正义。

sentences.en: This is what the chroniclers tell us at this point.
sentences.zh: 这就是当时的编年史家告诉我们的。

sentences.en: He takes the throne because he can bring peace.
sentences.zh: 他夺取王位是因为他能带来和平。

sentences.en: He can bring justice.
sentences.zh: 他能带来正义。

sentences.en: He fits the job.
sentences.zh: 他很适合这份工作。

sentences.en: And so for the first year or so, it looks as though there's a sort of virtuous circle operating in his favour.
sentences.zh: 所以在大约第一年里，看起来有一种良性循环对他有利。

sentences.en: Poor old Matilda is off in a castle in the south of Normandy having given birth to her third son.
sentences.zh: 可怜的玛蒂尔达在诺曼底南部的一座城堡里，刚生下了她的第三个儿子。

sentences.en: Such bad timing.
sentences.zh: 时机太差了。

sentences.en: Such bad timing.
sentences.zh: 时机太差了。

sentences.en: But her husband is trying to push into Normandy to try and stake her claim there.
sentences.zh: 但她的丈夫正试图打入诺曼底，试图在那里确立她的主张。

sentences.en: But it looks as though England is loSt.
sentences.zh: 但看起来英格兰已经失去了。

sentences.en: Even Robert Earl of Gloucester,
sentences.zh: 甚至连格洛斯特伯爵罗伯特，

sentences.en: Matilda's illegitimate half-brother, who's held out for a while trying to resist the idea that Stephen is this irresistible force.
sentences.zh: 玛蒂尔达的私生子同父异母的兄弟，他坚持了一段时间，试图抵制斯蒂芬是不可阻挡的力量这一观点。

sentences.en: He gives in at Easter 1136 and it looks as though Stephen's got it all but it's not long before it starts going wrong.
sentences.zh: 他在1136年复活节屈服了，看起来斯蒂芬已经胜券在握，但没过多久情况就开始恶化了。

sentences.en: So is this a reflection of the fact that we haven't really talked about
sentences.zh: 那么这是否反映了我们之前并没有真正讨论过

sentences.en: Matilda's character up till now?
sentences.zh: 玛蒂尔达的性格？

sentences.en: Is she a very kind of obdurate woman, a determined woman, someone who's not prepared to let this?
sentences.zh: 她是一个非常固执的女人，一个坚定的女人，一个不准备放弃的人吗？

sentences.en: Matilda is not going to let her inheritance go.
sentences.zh: 玛蒂尔达不会放弃她的继承权。

sentences.en: She won't let it go for her own sake.
sentences.zh: 为了她自己，她也不会放弃。

sentences.en: She is the daughter of Henry I.
sentences.zh: 她是亨利一世的女儿。

sentences.en: Of course, but little baby Henry.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有小亨利宝宝。

sentences.en: But she is the mother of sons.
sentences.zh: 但她是儿子的母亲。

sentences.en: She's had to marry...
sentences.zh: 她不得不嫁给……

sentences.en: With his little red hair and his little red face.
sentences.zh: 带着他那红头发和红脸蛋。

sentences.en: She's had to marry this plantagenet youngster that she didn't want to have anything to do with but she's done it in order to get these sons
sentences.zh: 她不得不嫁给这个她根本不想理会的金雀花王朝年轻人，但她为了得到这些儿子还是这么做了，

sentences.en: and she is not going to let their inheritance go.
sentences.zh: 她绝不会放弃他们的继承权。

sentences.en: It's quite hard to get a sense of the detail of Matilda's character with all these women.
sentences.zh: 对于所有这些女性，很难详细了解玛蒂尔达的性格。

sentences.en: The chroniclers don't really give us...
sentences.zh: 编年史家并没有真正给我们……

sentences.en: She's clearly tough, isn't she?
sentences.zh: 她显然很强硬，不是吗？

sentences.en: ...thumbnail sketches in the same way.
sentences.zh: ……像那样简短的素描。

sentences.en: She is very, very tough.
sentences.zh: 她非常、非常强硬。

sentences.en: Even though...
sentences.zh: 即使……

sentences.en: I mean, it's really interesting.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这真的很有趣。

sentences.en: If you read the chronicles, they're almost trying not to mention her.
sentences.zh: 如果你读编年史，他们几乎是在试图不提她。

sentences.en: There are two chronicles at this point.
sentences.zh: 当时有两部编年史。

sentences.en: The Gesta Stefani, which is the deeds of Stephen, so we know who the hero is there.
sentences.zh: 《斯蒂芬事迹》，所以我们知道谁是那里的英雄。

sentences.en: He tries not to mention her.
sentences.zh: 他尽量不提她。

sentences.en: He says the Countess of Anjou or the Earl of Gloucester's sister.
sentences.zh: 他称她为安茹伯爵夫人或格洛斯特伯爵的妹妹。

sentences.en: He doesn't really want to let her on stage.
sentences.zh: 他真的不想让她登场。

sentences.en: Certainly not calling her the Empress.
sentences.zh: 当然更不会称她为女皇。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Whereas William of Malmesbury, who's much more sympathetic, his hero is Robert of Gloucester, her half-brother.
sentences.zh: 而威廉·马姆斯伯里则更具同情心，他的英雄是格洛斯特的罗伯特，她同父异母的兄弟。

sentences.en: So we get glimpses of Matilda around the edges but every glimpse we get shows us how tough she is.
sentences.zh: 所以我们从侧面瞥见了玛蒂尔达，但每一次瞥见都向我们展示了她有多强硬。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So you can judge her by her actions and her actions essentially are to aim not just to secure Normandy but to claim the throne of England.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以通过她的行动来评判她，她的行动本质上不仅是为了确保诺曼底，还要夺取英格兰的王位。

sentences.en: By 1139, so we are four years into Stephen's reign now, it is clear that Stephen is struggling to get any kind of foothold in Normandy.
sentences.zh: 到1139年，也就是斯蒂芬统治的第四年，很明显斯蒂芬在诺曼底难以立足。

sentences.en: Matilda and Geoffrey are doing well there and that's going to be a structural problem for him because if he can only claim half the Anglo-Norman realm,
sentences.zh: 玛蒂尔达和杰弗里在那里做得很好，这对斯蒂芬来说将是一个结构性问题，因为如果他只能宣称拥有盎格鲁-诺曼王国的一半，

sentences.en: he's going to struggle to get all the barons to follow him but Matilda in 1139 does the key thing.
sentences.zh: 他将很难让所有的男爵都追随他，但玛蒂尔达在1139年做了关键的一步。

sentences.en: She gets herself to England because that's where she's going to stay.
sentences.zh: 她去了英格兰，因为那是她要待的地方。

sentences.en: So how does she get a foothold there?
sentences.zh: 那么她是如何在那里立足的呢？

sentences.en: It's a brave move.
sentences.zh: 这是一个勇敢的举动。

sentences.en: So we can say she's brave as well as tough.
sentences.zh: 所以我们可以说她不仅强硬，而且勇敢。

sentences.en: We can say she's very brave.
sentences.zh: 我们可以说她非常勇敢。

sentences.en: She and Robert of Gloucester, her half-brother, take ship for England and they land...
sentences.zh: 她和她同父异母的兄弟格洛斯特的罗伯特乘船前往英格兰，他们登陆了……

sentences.en: They don't hit a rock.
sentences.zh: 他们没有撞上岩石。

sentences.en: They don't hit a rock firSt.
sentences.zh: 他们首先没有撞上岩石。

sentences.en: First victory.
sentences.zh: 第一次胜利。

sentences.en: She's done better than her brother already.
sentences.zh: 她已经比她兄弟做得更好了。

sentences.en: She lands at Arundel in Sussex and this is very canny because they've only got a small bodyguard with them.
sentences.zh: 她在萨塞克斯的阿伦德尔登陆，这非常精明，因为他们只带了少数保镖。

sentences.en: But Arundel Castle is held by
sentences.zh: 但阿伦德尔城堡由

sentences.en: Matilda's widowed stepmother,
sentences.zh: 玛蒂尔达守寡的继母持有，

sentences.en: Adeliza of Louvain, who's the same age as her, this young woman that her father had married after her brother died.
sentences.zh: 鲁汶的阿德莉莎，她和玛蒂尔达同龄，是她父亲在她哥哥死后娶的年轻女子。

sentences.en: Adeliza's remarried, but Matilda and Adeliza do know each other of old.
sentences.zh: 阿德莉莎改嫁了，但玛蒂尔达和阿德莉莎确实是老相识。

sentences.en: They seem to have a lot of respect for each other and Adeliza lets Matilda into the castle.
sentences.zh: 她们似乎非常尊重对方，阿德莉莎让玛蒂尔达进入了城堡。

sentences.en: Robert of Gloucester spirits himself away to his stronghold in Bristol.
sentences.zh: 格洛斯特的罗伯特溜回了他在布里斯托尔的据点。

sentences.en: But Stephen has now got a problem.
sentences.zh: 但斯蒂芬现在遇到了麻烦。

sentences.en: Matilda's in the country.
sentences.zh: 玛蒂尔达在境内。

sentences.en: She's in a castle with the ex-queen, the Queen Dowager.
sentences.zh: 她和前王后、太后待在一座城堡里。

sentences.en: Is he going to besiege them?
sentences.zh: 他要围攻她们吗？

sentences.en: Is he going to try to capture them?
sentences.zh: 他要试图俘虏她们吗？

sentences.en: And what's that going to look like?
sentences.zh: 那看起来会是什么样子？

sentences.en: Here's a moment where being a woman can actually help you.
sentences.zh: 这是一个身为女性实际上可以帮助你的时刻。

sentences.en: If she was a man, then all bets are off.
sentences.zh: 如果她是男人，那一切就都完了。

sentences.en: It's war.
sentences.zh: 那是战争。

sentences.en: But she's a woman.
sentences.zh: 但她是女人。

sentences.en: Is Stephen really going to besiege?
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬真的要围攻吗？

sentences.en: So there's a kind of hint of chivalry there?
sentences.zh: 所以那里有一种骑士精神的暗示？

sentences.en: Chivalry, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 骑士精神，绝对是。

sentences.en: Stephen is not going to do his image as king any good if he is seen to be treating two royal women without due deference, without due respect.
sentences.zh: 如果斯蒂芬被视为对两位王室女性缺乏应有的礼貌和尊重，那对他作为国王的形象没有任何好处。

sentences.en: So it's a little bit like in the series we did on 1970s Britain,
sentences.zh: 所以这有点像我们做的关于1970年代英国的系列节目，
